title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

Senior SAP Ariba Consultant
  
  

**Experience:** 8\-12\+ Years
  
**Location:** India / Global Delivery
  
**Employment Type:** Full Time
  
  

Role Summary
  
  

The Senior SAP Ariba Consultant will lead the design, implementation, integration, and support of SAP Ariba solutions across Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes. The role requires deep expertise in SAP Ariba modules, SAP S/4HANA integration, stakeholder management, and end\-to\-end project delivery. The consultant will work closely with business users, procurement teams, vendors, and technical teams to drive procurement transformation initiatives.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Functional \& Solution Delivery
  
  

Lead end\-to\-end SAP Ariba implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and support projects.
  
Gather business requirements and conduct fit\-gap analysis.
  
  

**Configure and support SAP Ariba modules:**  

Ariba Sourcing
  
Buying \& Invoicing
  
Contracts Management
  
Supplier Lifecycle \& Performance (SLP)
  
Supplier Risk
  
Guided Buying
  
Catalog Management
  
Design procurement workflows, approval processes, sourcing events, and supplier onboarding solutions.
  
Conduct workshops and solution demonstrations with business stakeholders.
  
  

Integration \& Technical Activities
  
  

Lead integration of SAP Ariba with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and third\-party systems.
  
  

**Strong experience with:**  

SAP Ariba CIG (Cloud Integration Gateway)
  
APIs, IDOCs, and middleware integrations
  
Ariba Network enablement
  
Support master data migration, interface testing, and cutover activities.
  
  

Testing \& Deployment
  
  

Prepare functional specifications and support development teams.
  
Lead SIT, UAT, regression, and end\-to\-end testing activities.
  
Drive go\-live, hypercare, and post\-production support.
  
Perform issue resolution and root cause analysis
  
  

Stakeholder Management
  
  

Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT teams.
  
Lead client workshops and business process discussions.
  
Provide user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
  
Mentor junior consultants and support presales/RFP activities.
  
  

Required Skills
  
  

SAP Ariba Expertise
  
  

SAP Ariba Sourcing
  
Buying \& Invoicing
  
Contracts
  
Supplier Management/SLP
  
Guided Buying
  
Catalog Management
  
Supplier Enablement
  
Ariba Network
  
  

Integration Skills
  
  

SAP Ariba CIG
  
SAP S/4HANA Integration
  
SAP ECC Integration
  
APIs, IDOCs, Middleware
  
Master Data Management
  
  

Business Process Knowledge
  
  

Source\-to\-Pay (S2P)
  
Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
  
Supplier Collaboration
  
Contract Lifecycle Management
  
Procurement Operations
  
Strategic Sourcing
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or related discipline.
  
8\+ years of SAP consulting experience with 4\+ years in SAP Ariba.
  
Minimum 2\-3 end\-to\-end SAP Ariba implementation projects.
  
SAP Ariba Certification (Preferred).
  
Experience in global rollout and transformation programs.
  
  

Soft Skills
  
  

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
  
Leadership and mentoring capability.
  
Ability to work independently in global delivery environments.
  
Client\-facing consulting experience.
  
  

Preferred Experience
  
  

SAP S/4HANA Procurement Transformation
  
Global Procurement Programs
  
Supplier Risk Management
  
Procurement Analytics \& Reporting
  
Presales, Solutioning, and RFP Support
  
Agile/Scrum Delivery Model

title: Senior IT Program & Project Management Analyst
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

  

**Job Track Description:**


The Senior IT Program \& Project Management Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, governance, reporting, and delivery of IT projects. This role partners with delivery teams, business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leaders to ensure successful delivery of IT initiatives.


The position provides PMO leadership, project controls, portfolio reporting, risk and issue management, schedule governance, resource planning support, and executive\-level communications while driving consistency with organizational project management standards and best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project Governance**


* Support execution of multiple IT projects across the organization.
* Establish and maintain project governance processes, standards, and controls.
* Facilitate project reviews and status reporting.
* Ensure compliance with project management methodologies and organizational standards.
* Track project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

**Planning and Delivery Management**


* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule variances.
* Support release planning, implementation planning, and delivery readiness activities.

**Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management**


* Maintain project risk, issue, action item, and decision logs.
* Facilitate identification, assessment, and mitigation of delivery risks.
* Escalate critical issues and dependencies to leadership with recommended corrective actions.
* Monitor mitigation plans through resolution.

**Reporting and Executive Communication**


* Prepare executive\-level project status reports.
* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and portfolio metrics.
* Present project health, risks, achievements, and delivery forecasts to leadership.
* Generate management reports using project management and reporting tools.

**Financial Management**


* Assist with project budget monitoring and financial reporting.
* Track project expenditures and identify budget variances.

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and customers.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, planning sessions, and governance reviews.
* Drive stakeholder alignment on priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Ensure effective communication across all levels of the organization.

**PMO Process Improvement**


* Identify opportunities for improving project delivery processes.
* Drive adoption of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and project management best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the PMO.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT project management, PMO, or project governance roles.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, and SAFe.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Required Skills**


* Project management
* Project planning and scheduling
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder management
* Financial and resource management
* Executive reporting and presentations
* Requirements tracking and traceability
* Change management
* Vendor management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Tools Experience**


* Microsoft Project
* Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Microsoft Office
* Microsoft Power BI

**Preferred Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* SAFe Agilist (SA)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Scrum Master Certification
